E0031

Teaching: `unsafe` / C-style FFI → `extern rust` (S50)

What

Teaching: `unsafe` / C-style FFI → `extern rust` (S50)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0031

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0031: tests/ui/unsafe_extern_rust_teaching.stderr.

Error [E0031]: Jet doesn't use `unsafe` to call Rust crates
  --> tests/ui/unsafe_extern_rust_teaching.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | unsafe extern rust "demo@1" {
    | ^^^^^^
 Why: foreign Rust functions live in whole `extern rust` blocks — callers never write `unsafe`
 Fix: write: extern rust "crate@version" { fn name(...) T = "rust::path"; }
